failure_reason: RH's mega-menu flyout panel intermittently failed to render on repeated interactions (client-side rendering fault, not a block), which prevented reliable access to a few niche leaf categories (Rugs > Antique & Vintage Rugs, Rugs > Custom-Sized Rugs, and deeper RH Baby & Child bedding/windows subcategories beyond Duvet Covers & Shams). All qty figures actually recorded are exact site-reported RESULTS counts with verified h1/URL match; no numbers were estimated. Given the extreme breadth of RH's catalog (main site + RH Estates curated line + RH Baby & Child + RH Teen sub-storefronts), research was scoped to the main rh.com site (fully covered) plus RH Baby & Child's Storage-relevant and a representative Bedding sample; RH Teen was not explored (out of scope for this pass).
notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (rh.com/robots.txt) checked first - no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-* disallow, only specific paths (checkout, search, my-account, graphql, etc) blocked - proceeded. Site loaded fine in browser, no CAPTCHA/DataDome/403 encountered. TREE: built via rh.com mega-menu (TEXTILES, RUGS, BED, BATH, DÉCOR, OUTDOOR top-nav items) plus each category's own right-column sub-nav. rh.com is 'The World of RH' - a multi-brand storefront: main site, an 'RH Estates' curated line (Estates Textiles/Rugs/etc mirror the same categories as a Collections-style curation - excluded per collections rule, confirmed by one sample 'Cashmere Throws' link resolving to a /collections.jsp URL with no RESULTS count, just sub-collection tiles), and two separate subdomains reachable from the main nav: rhbabyandchild.rh.com (explored: Bedding/Décor/Windows/Rugs/Bath menus) and rhteen.rh.com (not explored - out of scope). QTY: every recorded qty is the exact 'RESULTS (N)' text rendered on the category listing page, confirmed against the page h1 matching the clicked node name. URLs are the canonical /catalog/category/products.jsp/catXXXXX listing pages (never product-detail/search/collection URLs); the main 'Rugs' node's URL was confirmed via the site's own search box which auto-redirected 'rugs' to its canonical ALL RUGS category page (h1 'ALL RUGS', RESULTS 1066) rather than a /search/ results page. EXCLUDED (Textile): all '*Collections' facet/curation links (Bedding Collections, Pillow Collections, Throw Collections, Drapery Collections, Bath Towel Collections, Cashmere/Faux Fur Throws which resolved to collections.jsp), all 'Rugs By Style/Size/Color/Fiber' facet-browse links (same catalog as main Rugs, not distinct product sets), 'Rug Pads' (not a decorative/floor textile per rules), all 'RH Estates *' nav items (curated re-presentation of the same core categories, collections-style), Window Hardware (hardware, not textile), Fabric Seating/Leather Seating/Ottomans (furniture). EXCLUDED (Storage): 'Floor Accessories & Storage' (Bath Accessories submenu) - actual contents are wastebaskets and tissue holders, not storage/organization containers, so excluded despite the category name; 'Boxes' under Décor > Decorative Accents - h1 renders 'DECORATIVE BOXES', contents are trinket/keepsake boxes (brass, marble, pyrite) with no storage function, excluded per Decorative-vs-Storage boundary; Cabinet Hardware, Shelving & Cabinets under LIVING/DINING (explicitly Furniture-nav, not Storage-nav, per rule 21 site-hierarchy tiebreak); 'Wall Storage & Shelving' (RH Baby & Child) included but flagged LOW confidence - product names are explicitly 'Display Shelf' (decorative-leaning) despite sitting in a nav path literally named Storage. RH Estates Rugs / Estates Textiles not separately re-extracted (same underlying category tree, collections-style presentation). No robots.txt block, no CAPTCHA. Duplicate prevention: Bed Linens 'Comforters, Pillow Inserts & Essentials' (cat9790054, qty16) and Pillows 'Pillow Inserts' (cat9790053, qty6) are two genuinely different URLs/listings (parent bundle page vs dedicated subcategory) - both kept per the different-listing-URL rule.
